span: the first round of proceedings for assessment for the assessment year 1971-1972
why: An income-tax assessment dispute that only mentions an earlier enhancement of compensation as background.

span: the original land owners/claimants have preferred the present appeals seeking enhancement of the amount of compensation for the lands acquired
why: States that landowners appeal for enhancement; the court's decision is not in the passage.

span: Relying upon s.28(A), claim of appellant for re-determination of compensation in accordance with enhanced compensation awarded to his father and brother
why: Headnote records the s.28A claim and the start of the Held portion; the decision to grant the enhanced rate appears in the next passage.

span: The Reference Court, by its award dated 09.05.1989 in reference case No. L.A.O.P. No.337/88 enhanced the rate of compensation of the acquired land
why: Facts of an earlier enhancement; the Supreme Court's own ruling is elsewhere.

span: the High Court has partly allowed the appeals preferred by the land owners and determined and awarded the compensation at Rs. 2,98,54,720/- per acre
why: Facts: the High Court enhanced compensation and the State appeals; no Supreme Court holding in the passage.

span: Compensation for the entire land owned by the Company is wholly unwarranted, illegal and unduly advantageous to the Company
why: Headnote holding: the enhanced compensation determined for the entire land is rejected and the company's claim for further enhancement is untenable.

span: the High Court has determined and enhanced the amount of compensation to Rs. 7,00,000/- per acre
why: Facts: the High Court enhanced compensation and landowners seek more; the Supreme Court's decision is not in the passage.
